//: The gate imports the UI's own server actions (`ui/lib/actions.ts`) so that
«Підтвердити», «Ще спроба» and «Відхилити» are tested through the SAME code
the buttons call, not through a reimplementation of it that could drift.
Those modules resolve `@/…` and `@factory/…`, which are Next path aliases
declared in `ui/tsconfig.json`. tsx honours `paths` from the tsconfig it
loads, so the gate gets its own config carrying both alias sets rather than
polluting the root build config (rootDir `src`) with UI paths.
`allowJs`/`jsx` are here because a few of those modules pull in .tsx
